changes: Match ADD_CHAR callbacks by CREATING state, owning service, current pending characteristic and UUID; set FAILED on creation errors.
Remove per-connection notification subscription on disconnect; log CCCD changes. The later bonded-persistence patch retains the authenticated speaker subscription in native preferences.
Register GAP callback through the existing ESPHome code-generation helper.
Respond to peer SEC_REQ for Just Works, log authentication success/failure and reject unexpected NoIO passkey/numeric-comparison requests. Never initiate a duplicate security procedure.
Normalize integer UUIDs <= 0xFFFF to from_uint16 so assigned descriptors, including automatically generated CCCDs, retain 16-bit ATT wire encoding; wider integers remain from_uint32.
Add VERBOSE-only GATTS CREATE/START/ADD_CHAR/ADD_DESCR completion status and handles, plus READ handle and WRITE handle/length/need_rsp. No payload or security key logging.
Include remote peer MAC in the existing CONNECT debug log and disconnect reason in the existing DISCONNECT debug log, without changing connection behavior.

Delay initial server advertising request until every configured service is RUNNING, so directed reconnection cannot race HID service creation; retain the existing advertising-required/reference-count mechanism.

Persist actual CCCD writes (including 0000) in ESPHome native flash preferences keyed by the exact speaker identity, HID service and Input Report ID read from 2908; sync writes immediately. No assumed/default subscription.

Restore only after successful authentication for the currently connected exact public speaker and a matching saved bond. Restore the IDF CCCD through esp_ble_gatts_set_attr_value, then populate the new connection notification table only after successful SET_ATTR_VAL completion. Clear live CCCD/notification state on disconnect without deleting saved state.

Restrict persisted HID report notifications to the authenticated speaker. A real CCCD write on the current connection takes precedence over saved state, including writes before authentication finishes.

When a real CCCD write races a pending restore, enqueue the actual latest value after the old stack update before cancelling the pending application restore, so unsubscribe wins in both IDF and application state.

Add explicit start_speaker_pairing maintenance action: remove only the verified speaker bond, suppress reconnection/CCCD persistence while pending, wait for successful bond removal and target disconnect, clear only the three target CCCD preferences to 0000 with immediate sync, then refresh ordinary advertising. No mass bond or NVS reset.

Scope GATTS lifecycle to the exact public speaker in local peripheral role, and ATT events to its server connection ID. Ignore outgoing original-remote lifecycle before service dispatch so remote disconnect cannot clear speaker CCCDs. Scope server GAP security responses/authentication to speaker; expose can_notify() using existing authenticated subscriber state for raw relay and HA gating.

BLECharacteristic::notify returns whether at least one send_indicate call returned ESP_OK. Preserve authenticated-subscriber filtering and stop after a send error; retain acceptance if an earlier send succeeded. Existing callers may ignore the return value; no speaker execution ACK is inferred.
